summary: This directory serves as the entry point for the form generation engine. It centralizes the initialization and exposure of automated form handling logic, providing a unified interface for defining, validating, and managing dynamic form structures based on schema configurations.
responsibilities: Export and expose the automated form generation system
Provide a unified access point for form management logic
relationships: This directory serves as the public gateway to the form engine, exposing the underlying field configuration and schema validation capabilities to the rest of the application.
designDecisions: Re-export pattern for clean API surface
Centralized entry point for module encapsulation
